name: How to Merge PDF Files Free
description: Combine 2, 50, or 100+ PDF files into one document for free — no upload, no account, 100% private.

tool.name: PDFree — free browser-based PDF merger, no upload required

step.name: Add your PDF files
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF files into the drop zone. Add as many files as you need — 2, 50, or 100+ — there is no file count limit.

step.name: Reorder if needed
step.text: Drag and drop the file cards to set the exact order you want them merged in. Reorder as many times as you like before clicking Merge.

step.name: Merge and download
step.text: Click 'Merge PDF files'. Processing takes seconds for small batches, up to a minute for 50+ large files. The merged PDF downloads automatically to your device — nothing is uploaded to any server.
